# Domain: Widget Sales

## 1) Domain identity
- domain_key: widgets
- description: Widget sales data analysis

## 2) Metrics dictionary
- sales: Sum of sales values (numeric)

## 3) Dimensions dictionary
- product: Product name (text)
- region: Sales region (text: North, South, East, West)
- month: Month of sale (text)

## 4) Default rules
- supports_no_time_queries: true
- default_time_rule: null
- default_limit: 100
